headline: Oracle announces Fusion Companion for workflow execution through AI clients
summary: Oracle announced Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home, describing a way to direct Oracle Fusion workflows through supported AI tools such as ChatGPT or Oracle's native interface. Oracle says Fusion Companion can coordinate transactions, approvals and agents across enterprise systems while applying organization-defined permissions and controls. These are vendor-described capabilities; this review found no independent deployment measurements, security evaluation or realized productivity outcomes.
